approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly requested one persistent goal, autonomous best-plan choices and continuous execution without repeated approvals.
approval.scope: Exactly one zero-training P0 corrective over analytic unit scenes and six fixed poses in one C01 training world; C07, C10, graph replay and M-TARE are excluded.

purpose: Verify that a pre-Poisson implicit construction field can propagate exact edge-primitive source identity through union-aware LiDAR ray exits without assigning ambiguous hits to one primitive.

worlds.audit_scope: Only C01 graph, splines and geometry are read. C07 and C10 are named solely to establish their exclusion.

raw_sources: Sealed S01_flat_tree_small_C01 graph, splines and geometry parameters.
The sealed failed P0 audit proving archived Poisson faces and archived LiDAR lack source provenance.
Deterministic analytic T-junction, stacked non-incident tunnel and equal-operand ambiguity scenes.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of pinned Cano procedural assets; no third-party redistribution.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: One C01 procedural topology is the independent world unit; six fixed primitive-midpoint poses are deterministic implementation probes, not six independent worlds.
sampling.rule: Construct 55 edge-level operands from sealed C01 assets, then cast the native 16x720 angular pattern from exactly six predeclared edge-midpoint poses at a fixed 0.05 m field spacing and 50 m range.

split.fit: Only C01 is used and no parameter is fitted.
split.strict_test: C07, C10 and M-TARE are excluded.
split.historical_pollution_audit: No checkpoint, validation/test world, threshold, normalization statistic, augmentation choice or planner output is read.

teacher.source: Identity-preserving implicit union of one finite swept-tube operand per graph edge; the first exit from the union is refined by bisection and returns the complete active operand set.
teacher.valid_mask: A hit is valid for single-primitive parameter supervision only when its active source set has cardinality one. Multi-source hits retain their full membership vector, use primary index -1 and are masked from single-primitive losses.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: World ID, graph/TNG, edge/tunnel identity, mesh, absolute pose and future observations are Teacher-only and are not proposed as student inputs.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model, graph builder, planner or closed-loop execution is invoked in this corrective.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.analytic: All ten construction/provenance unit tests pass.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.count: Exactly 6 poses x 16 rows x 720 columns = 69,120 rays.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.identity: Every hit has a non-empty membership set; every unique hit has a valid primitive index; every ambiguous hit has primary index -1 and loss mask 0.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.determinism: A complete second ray cast is exactly equal to the first.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.bounds: All stored ranges are finite and within [0,50] m.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.system: Zero optimizer steps, model inference frames, C07/C10 reads, graph replays and M-TARE runs.

retention: Keep compressed Teacher rays with full source membership, primitive identity table, PNG/PDF/SVG, tests, summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
failure_policy: Any missing source, arbitrary ambiguous assignment, nondeterminism, count drift, bounds failure or forbidden data access is FAIL. Do not tune field spacing, ray pattern, poses or thresholds after seeing results.
